headline.title: Startup Battlefield 200 applications close in days: Apply before May 27
headline.summary: The application deadline for Startup Battlefield 200 is May 27, offering startups a chance to gain venture capital access, global visibility, and coverage from TechCrunch, along with a $100,000 prize. Interested parties are encouraged to apply or nominate before the closing date.

articles.title: 5 days left: Save up to $410 on TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 passes before prices increase
articles.summary: Early Bird registration for TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 in San Francisco ends on May 29 at 11:59 p.m. PT, offering savings of up to $410 on passes. Attendees are encouraged to register before the price increase.

articles.title: What ClickUp’s mass layoff tells us about the future of work
articles.summary: ClickUp is transitioning from a traditional workforce to a model that relies heavily on AI, resulting in the layoff of hundreds of employees as they implement thousands of AI agents. This move reflects a broader trend in the tech industry towards automation and AI integration in the workplace.

articles.title: Pope Leo calls for being ‘profoundly human’ in the age of AI
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV released his first major papal document, "Magnifica Humanitas," emphasizing the need to prioritize human dignity in the face of advancing artificial intelligence. The manifesto addresses concerns about AI's impact on warfare, labor, and the ethical implications of unchecked technological power.

articles.title: The pope’s AI encyclical isn’t really about AI
articles.summary: Pope Leo XIV's first encyclical addresses issues such as concentrated power and eroding democracy, using AI as a framework to explore these longstanding concerns. The document critiques the influence of a tech elite on society rather than focusing solely on artificial intelligence itself.

articles.title: US's big bet on quantum computing may not be entirely legal
articles.summary: The U.S. government's significant investment in quantum computing may face legal challenges, raising questions about the necessity of the newly launched quantum foundry company. Experts are debating the implications of this initiative amidst concerns over its compliance with existing regulations.

articles.title: OpenAI, Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL announce strategic content partnership
articles.summary: OpenAI has formed a strategic partnership with Grupo Folha and Grupo UOL to integrate trusted Brazilian journalism into ChatGPT, enhancing news accessibility while ensuring attribution and transparency. This collaboration aims to provide users with reliable news content in the Brazilian context.

articles.title: The AI Era Is Creating a Bug Hunting Arms Race
articles.summary: The increasing use of AI by attackers to develop exploits is intensifying the competition in the search for software vulnerabilities. This shift is prompting a reevaluation of bug hunting strategies in the cybersecurity landscape.

articles.title: Harness, Scaffold, and the AI Agent Terms Worth Getting Right
articles.summary: The article discusses the importance of accurately defining key terms related to AI agents, such as "harness" and "scaffold," to ensure clear communication and understanding in the field. It emphasizes that precise terminology is essential for effective collaboration and development in AI research and applications.

articles.title: NeuroNL2LTL: A Neurosymbolic Framework for Natural Language Translation of Linear Temporal Logic
articles.summary: NeuroNL2LTL is a neurosymbolic framework designed to translate natural language into Linear Temporal Logic (LTL), addressing the challenges of expertise and correctness in formal verification for safety-critical applications. This approach combines the fluency of neural methods with the reliability of formal verification, aiming to enhance the accessibility and accuracy of formal logic translations.

articles.title: ImProver 2: Iteratively Self-Improving LMs for Neurosymbolic Proof Optimization
articles.summary: ImProver 2 is a neurosymbolic framework designed to automate proof optimization, addressing challenges such as heterogeneous objectives and high training costs in formal mathematics. The framework aims to enhance the maintainability of verified proofs and improve the quality of training data for neural provers.

articles.title: Mediative Fuzzy Logic: From Type-1 Foundations to Type-2, Type-3 and Quantum Extensions
articles.summary: The article discusses the development of Mediative Fuzzy Logic, which aims to reconcile conflicting assessments in fuzzy control and decision-making. It presents a unified framework that extends from type-1 to interval type-2, granular type-3, and quantum fuzzy logic, focusing on the characterization of the mediative operator.
